newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks moderately higher in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks moderately higher in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were moderately higher in early morning trade on Friday. The benchmark Nikkei average was finding support around the 18,000 level, as the weaker yen encouraged investors to buy shares in export-oriented companies, brokers said.
At 0015 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was up 60.39 points or 0.33 percent at 18,098.82. Nikkei March futures gained 80 points to 18,110.
"The weak yen would prompt buying in export-oriented issues," said one broker. The yen retreated further overnight, with the dollar touching 124 yen, a fresh four-year high.
